description: Layer 4 software-composition analysis (SCA). Normalizes the raw OSV-Scanner output (results-osv.json) for the root yarn.lock into the unified audit schema, deduplicated by the (package, CVE) tuple, with severity banded into critical/high/medium/low.

severityBanding.source: OSV-computed CVSS base score (groups.max_severity); fallback to GitHub advisory severity; MAL-* -> critical

dedupe.fallbackKey: osvId (GHSA/MAL) when no CVE alias is present

gateModel.blocking: critical and high are gate-blocking by default
demotions: malicious packages (MAL-*) are never demoted (always blocking)
already-remediated: resolved version >= advisory fixed version
not-reachable: build/test tooling not present in the production runtime (devOnlyTooling)
resolution-pinned high findings whose remaining fix is an out-of-scope dependency upgrade
medium/low are advisory (below the blocking threshold)

summary.note: Normalized from results-osv.json (OSV-Scanner 2.3.5) over the root yarn.lock (Yarn Berry). Deduplicated by the (package, CVE-or-OSV-id) tuple, collapsing 257 raw vulnerability records into 172 unique findings and preserving the union of resolved versions and affected ranges (Directive 6). Severity banded into the unified critical/high/medium/low vocabulary from the OSV-computed CVSS base score (groups.max_severity: >=9.0 critical, 7.0-8.9 high, 4.0-6.9 medium, <4.0 low), falling back to the GitHub advisory severity when no CVSS score is present, with malicious packages (MAL-*) forced to critical (Directive 7). gateBlocking follows the gate model: critical/high are blocking unless demoted; demotions are recorded with a demotionReason for (a) already-remediated findings (resolved >= fixed; 0 in this dataset), (b) build/test tooling not reachable in the production runtime (devOnlyTooling), (c) resolution-pinned packages whose remaining fix is an out-of-scope upgrade (AAP S0.3.2/S0.4.2), and (d) medium/low advisories below the blocking threshold. Malicious packages are never demoted. This layer reports only; package.json and yarn.lock are unchanged. The final gate verdict is computed downstream in findings-merged.json.
